reason: I give free meals to creators all the time and honestly have no idea if anyone walks in because of them. If it is free and the sign-up really is two minutes, I will try it on the next creator I host, just to finally see a number.
objection: I don't have time to learn another app, and my counter boy will forget to tap redeem when it is rush hour, so the count will be wrong and I will stop trusting it.
would_change_my_mind: If the first creator post shows zero or nearly zero redemptions, or the staff PIN step slows the counter, I will quietly stop using it.
